## sqlpipe Architecture

sqlpipe moves data from Postgres to S3 in three stages. Each stage runs as an independent process in a pipeline.

**Reader.** The reader connects to Postgres and runs the source query. It gets rows in batches of a set size. Each batch goes into a shared buffer. The reader stops when it gets the last row or when it gets a cancel signal.

**Converter.** The converter takes each batch from the buffer. It changes the rows into a Parquet row group. It writes each row group to a local temporary file. Column types map directly from Postgres types to Parquet types.

**Uploader.** The uploader sends the Parquet file to S3 with the multipart upload API. It splits the file into parts and sends each part separately. If a part fails, the uploader tries again up to three times. After all parts are complete, the uploader tells S3 to assemble the object.
